name: Wensity UI
summary: Freemium motion-rich React components with a free MIT CLI tier.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry components of ~89 free items in https://ui.wensity.com/r/registry.json (plus fonts/base) — not a full inventory.
Freemium: Free ($0 forever) CLI + free MIT catalog; Pro Annual $169/yr and Pro Lifetime $199 unlock premium motion/agentic comps (HTTP 402 on /r/{slug} without license) — excluded.
Primary install is Wensity CLI (`pnpm dlx wensity@latest add`); registry JSON also fetchable for shadcn-compatible inspection.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Infinite Marquee
components.summary: Seamless GPU-only logo strip that loops without stutter.
components.copyCode:
pnpm dlx wensity@latest add infinite-marquee

import { InfiniteMarquee } from "@/components/wensity/infinite-marquee"

<InfiniteMarquee />

copyPrompt.text: Use Wensity UI free MIT component `Infinite Marquee` (slug `infinite-marquee`) from https://ui.wensity.com/components/infinite-marquee. Install with `pnpm dlx wensity@latest add infinite-marquee` (free CLI tier) or `npx wensity@latest add infinite-marquee`. Registry item: https://ui.wensity.com/r/infinite-marquee.json. Imports land under `@/components/wensity/infinite-marquee` as `InfiniteMarquee`. Requires React/Next + TypeScript + Tailwind; peers as listed in registry. License: MIT for free registry items (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wensity/registry/main/LICENSE). Pricing freemium — free CLI tier only; Pro Annual $169/yr / Pro Lifetime $199 excluded (paid comps return HTTP 402).
